hook.en: Before calculating anything, a good economist draws the data. A few dots on a graph can tell you at once whether two variables rise together, fall together or are unrelated.
hook.kn: ಲೆಕ್ಕ ಮಾಡುವ ಮೊದಲು ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಅರ್ಥಶಾಸ್ತ್ರಜ್ಞ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಚಿತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ನಕ್ಷೆಯ ಮೇಲಿನ ಕೆಲವು ಚುಕ್ಕೆಗಳು ಎರಡು ಚರಾಂಶಗಳು ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಏರುತ್ತವೆಯೇ ಅಥವಾ ಸಂಬಂಧವಿಲ್ಲವೇ ಎಂದು ತಕ್ಷಣ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

objectives.en: Read the direction and degree of correlation from it

narration.en: Before calculating anything, a good economist draws the data. A few dots on a graph can tell you at once whether two variables rise together, fall together or are unrelated.
narration.kn: ಲೆಕ್ಕ ಮಾಡುವ ಮೊದಲು ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಅರ್ಥಶಾಸ್ತ್ರಜ್ಞ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಚಿತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ನಕ್ಷೆಯ ಮೇಲಿನ ಕೆಲವು ಚುಕ್ಕೆಗಳು ಎರಡು ಚರಾಂಶಗಳು ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಏರುತ್ತವೆಯೇ ಅಥವಾ ಸಂಬಂಧವಿಲ್ಲವೇ ಎಂದು ತಕ್ಷಣ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: A scatter diagram plots each pair of values $(X, Y)$ as a dot. If the dots rise from left to right the correlation is positive; if they fall, it is negative. The closer the dots are to a straight line, the stronger the correlation. Dots with no pattern show no correlation, and a curved band shows a non-linear relationship.
body.kn: ವಿಕೀರ್ಣ ಚಿತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ಜೋಡಿ ಮೌಲ್ಯವನ್ನು ಒಂದು ಚುಕ್ಕೆಯಾಗಿ ಗುರುತಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ. ಏರುವ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಧನಾತ್ಮಕ, ಇಳಿಯುವ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಋಣಾತ್ಮಕ ಸಹಸಂಬಂಧ. ಚುಕ್ಕೆಗಳು ಸರಳರೇಖೆಗೆ ಹತ್ತಿರವಿದ್ದಷ್ಟು ಸಹಸಂಬಂಧ ಬಲವಾದದ್ದು. ಆದರೆ ಇದು ನಿಖರ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ನೀಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

points.en: Rising band: positive; falling band: negative
Tight band: high degree; wide band: low degree
All dots on a line: perfect correlation
It gives no exact numerical value

narration.en: A scatter diagram plots each pair of values as a dot. A rising band means positive correlation, a falling band negative. The tighter the dots hug a straight line, the stronger the correlation, but the diagram gives no exact number.

narration.en: The teacher plots five students' study hours against marks, draws the trend, and compares three typical scatter patterns.

say.en: Hours of study go on the X axis, marks on the Y axis. Each student becomes one dot.
The dots climb from left to right in a band. Draw the trend line through them: the correlation is positive.
Compare three patterns. A tight rising band is high positive; a tight falling band is high negative; a cloud is no correlation.
The scatter diagram shows direction and closeness at a glance, but it never gives an exact number. For that we need r.

caption.en: Points on a straight line show perfect correlation. Change the slope of the line and watch its direction flip.

narration.en: If every dot lay exactly on this line, the correlation would be perfect. A positive slope means plus one, a negative slope means minus one.

tryThis.en: Make the slope negative: what kind of perfect correlation is this?
Make the slope zero: does Y depend on X?

caption.en: Dots scatter around Y = 5 + bX with a spread s. The two outer lines mark the band where most dots fall. The readout estimates r (X spread evenly from 0 to 10).

narration.en: Widen the band by raising the spread, and watch r fall towards zero. Narrow it and r moves towards plus or minus one.

tryThis.en: Keep b = 1 and raise s from 0.5 to 10. What happens to r?
Make b negative. What happens to the sign of r?
Can you get r close to zero without making b zero?

problem.en: Marks of five students against hours of study are (1, 2), (2, 4), (3, 5), (4, 4), (5, 5). Draw a scatter diagram and describe the correlation.

steps.en: Take hours on the X axis and marks on the Y axis; plot the five dots.
The dots rise from left to right, so the correlation is positive.
They do not lie on one straight line but stay in a fairly narrow band.
So there is a fairly high (but not perfect) positive correlation.

answer.en: Positive correlation of a fairly high degree, not perfect

homework.en: Draw a scatter diagram for the heights and weights of any six family members and describe the correlation.

narration.en: Recap. A scatter diagram plots each pair of values as a dot. A rising band shows positive and a falling band negative correlation. The tighter the dots around a line, the stronger the correlation. It gives no exact numerical value of correlation.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ವಿಕೀರ್ಣ ಚಿತ್ರವು ಪ್ರತಿ ಜೋಡಿ ಮೌಲ್ಯವನ್ನು ಒಂದು ಚುಕ್ಕೆಯಾಗಿ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಏರುವ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಧನಾತ್ಮಕ, ಇಳಿಯುವ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಋಣಾತ್ಮಕ ಸಹಸಂಬಂಧ. ಚುಕ್ಕೆಗಳು ರೇಖೆಗೆ ಹತ್ತಿರವಿದ್ದಷ್ಟು ಸಹಸಂಬಂಧ ಬಲವಾದದ್ದು. ಇದು ಸಹಸಂಬಂಧದ ನಿಖರ ಸಂಖ್ಯಾ ಮೌಲ್ಯ ನೀಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
